author: raman118
body:
#### References to other Issues or PRs

Fixes [#18349](https://github.com/sympy/sympy/issues/18349).

#### Brief description of what is fixed or changed

Added parentheses around products inside LaTeX derivatives. This distinguishes a derivative of a product from a derivative multiplied by a noncommutative factor.

Added regression tests for ordinary and mixed partial derivatives and updated the existing product-derivative expectation.

#### Other comments

Validation:

- Regression test failed before the fix and passed afterward.
- LaTeX printer tests: 180 passed, 2 xfailed.
- LaTeX doctests: 2 passed.
- Code-quality tests: 6 passed, 1 deselected.
- Repository-wide Ruff, local author checks, and diff checks passed.

Updated `.mailmap` to map both existing Doremon aliases to `raman118 <rcho38706@gmail.com>`.

#### AI Generation Disclosure

OpenAI Codex (GPT-6 Astra) generated the changes in `.mailmap`, `sympy/printing/latex.py`, and `sympy/printing/tests/test_latex.py`
#### Release Notes

<!-- BEGIN RELEASE NOTES -->
* printing
  * Fixed ambiguous LaTeX output for derivatives of products by parenthesizing the differentiated expression.
<!-- END RELEASE NOTES -->

issue_comments.body:
```python
from sympy import Derivative, Function, UnevaluatedExpr, latex
from sympy.abc import x

f = Function('f')
g = Function('g', commutative=False)

a = Derivative(UnevaluatedExpr(f(x)*g(x)), x)
b = Derivative(f(x), x)*g(x)

assert latex(a) != latex(b)  # Still fails
```

Maybe you need
```python
if (self._settings['mul_symbol'] or
        precedence_traditional(expr.expr) == precedence):
    precedence += 1
```

linked.author: mcpl-sympy
linked.body:
Here is an example:
```python
from sympy import Derivative, Function
from sympy.abc import x
f = Function('f')
g = Function('g', commutative=False)
### These two result are printed identically
Derivative(f(x), x) * g(x)
Derivative(f(x)*g(x), x)
```

Thus, I suggest that ``Derivative.expr`` be parenthesized with ``PRECEDENCE['Mul']`` when printed.
linked.title: Derivative.expr must be parenthesized when printed
